runbooks.name: CI Verification Tracker
schedule_lines: Initial dispatch: manual one-shot per category day (enamel / pva / waterproofing)
runbooks.purpose: Collect rep-level confirmation of which competitor products (Africa Paints, Anetic, Crest, Excelsior, Golden Choice) are sold into the field across three categories (Enamel / PVA / Waterproofing), giving us a **75-cell matrix** (5 competitors × 3 categories × 5 reps). Each cell is a single Supabase form the rep fills out. The completed matrix is the source of truth for which competitors are realistically in-market in our territory.
runbooks.html:
Purpose

Collect rep-level confirmation of which competitor products (Africa Paints, Anetic, Crest, Excelsior, Golden Choice) are sold into the field across three categories (Enamel / PVA / Waterproofing), giving us a 75-cell matrix (5 competitors × 3 categories × 5 reps). Each cell is a single Supabase form the rep fills out. The completed matrix is the source of truth for which competitors are realistically in-market in our territory.

Why it exists: prior competitor intelligence was a mix of TDS scraping, retail ad spotting, and rep folklore. The 75-cell matrix forces each rep to make a definite claim about what they actually see on shelves, which then anchors all downstream battlecard work.

How it runs

  1. Initial dispatch (manual one-shot per category) — python send_verification_emails.py --day enamel|pva|waterproofing creates 25 forms for that category (5 competitors × 5 reps), sends each rep one email per competitor with a pre-filled form link (?rep=AC&email=...&competitor=anetic&category=enamel), and logs each dispatch to the ci_dispatch_log Supabase table. Submit-once enforced by rep_code in form_submissions.metadata.

  2. Daily reminder (weekday 07:00, Task \Olympic Paints\Competitor Intel\Send CI Reminders) — python send_ci_reminders.py runs. For each rep:

    • Queries Supabase: form_submissions (what's already submitted) + ci_dispatch_log (what's been sent + when first sent).
    • Computes outstanding = (form_id, rep_code) in sent_set AND NOT in submitted_set.
    • Sends one digest email per rep with a clickable list of every outstanding (competitor, category) tile.
    • Logs each reminder as a kind="reminder" row in ci_dispatch_log for audit trail.
    • Telegram-pings Quintus with a per-rep summary: AC ✓ all done / BV ! 3 OVERDUE · 5 total outstanding.
    • Overdue = first sent more than 5 weekdays ago.

  3. Pull results — python pull_verification_results.py aggregates Supabase submissions into output/verification_results.xlsx for reporting / sharing.

  4. Live dashboard — /ci-tracker page on the Olympic Portal (Next.js app) at olympic-paints-portal.vercel.app/ci-tracker. Renders the 75-cell matrix live from Supabase.

Inputs

  • 3.Resources/17. Strategic Intelligence/_verification/.env:
    • SUPABASE_URL
    • SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY (required by reminder script)
    • FORM_ADMIN_SECRET
  • 3.Resources/17. Strategic Intelligence/_verification/config/rep_emails.json — rep code → name + email
  • 3.Resources/17. Strategic Intelligence/_verification/output/supabase_form_ids.json — 15 form IDs keyed by competitor + category
  • 3.Resources/17. Strategic Intelligence/_verification/templates/reminder_email.html — Jinja-ish template (string replace)
  • 1.Projects/PULSE — Sales & Ops Manager/.env — TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN
  • Supabase tables: form_submissions, ci_dispatch_log

Outputs

  • Outlook emails (one per rep per reminder cycle; one per (rep × competitor) on initial dispatch)
  • Supabase form submissions
  • ci_dispatch_log rows (dispatch + reminder events; kind column distinguishes them)
  • Telegram summary to chat 8042233389 (per-day per-rep matrix snapshot)
  • Live dashboard: https://olympic-paints-portal.vercel.app/ci-tracker
  • output/verification_results.xlsx (manual via pull_verification_results.py)

Known failure modes

Symptom Cause Fix
Reminder script fails: "SUPABASE_URL or SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY not set" .env missing the service-role key Add SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY=... to _verification/.env. Service role is needed because ci_dispatch_log writes bypass RLS.
Reminder Telegram says "all done" but reps haven't submitted form_submissions.metadata.rep_code not set on a submission Frontend must include rep_code in the URL query string and the form must surface it into metadata. Check olympic-paints-forms-admin form schema.
Forms work but submit twice from same rep Submit-once enforcement broken The frontend enforces this by checking metadata; if it stopped, add a unique index on (form_id, metadata->>'rep_code') in Supabase.
Reminder script runs on weekend Forgot --force is needed to bypass weekend check; or weekend check broken Default behaviour skips Sat/Sun. Use --force if you want to run on a weekend; otherwise no action needed.
All reps see the same competitor in the digest URL query string not built per-rep Check build_link() in send_ci_reminders.py — rep, email, competitor, category all must be encoded.
TLS error fetching Supabase Local AV doing TLS inspection without truststore.inject_into_ssl() Script already calls truststore.inject_into_ssl(). If new helper script added, must do the same. See [Memory: feedback_python_truststore_for_https].

Logs

  • Task Scheduler History tab for \Olympic Paints\Competitor Intel\*
  • ci_dispatch_log Supabase table (full audit trail of every send)
  • Outlook Sent Items
  • Telegram message history (chat 8042233389)

Manual run

cd "3.Resources/17. Strategic Intelligence/_verification"

# Initial dispatch (one category at a time)
python send_verification_emails.py --day enamel
python send_verification_emails.py --day pva
python send_verification_emails.py --day waterproofing

# Reminder cycle (normally weekday 07:00)
python send_ci_reminders.py                  # live
python send_ci_reminders.py --dry-run        # sends only to quintusl@
python send_ci_reminders.py --force          # ignore weekend check

# Pull submissions into Excel for reporting
python pull_verification_results.py

Recent incidents

  • No recent incidents recorded. First reminder ran cleanly on go-live week.

  • [[reference_competitor_verification_forms]] — Supabase forms backend reference
  • [[store-health-feedback]] — sister system, same forms backend, similar reminder pattern (this runbook was the architectural template for it)
  • [[reference_olympic_portal_v1]] — portal app that hosts /ci-tracker
  • [[feedback_python_truststore_for_https]] — TLS-inspection fix

runbooks.name: HAVEN Clocking Pipeline
runbooks.purpose: Convert raw Advius biometric punch exports into a year-to-date Excel workbook and a live HTML dashboard covering all 102 employees (74 Olympic Paints + 28 Primeserve). Tracks total worked hours, missed clock-outs, and per-employer / per-department breakdowns. The output is what Sejal and accounts use to run payroll-adjacent decisions and what Quintus reviews each Monday.
runbooks.html:
Purpose

Convert raw Advius biometric punch exports into a year-to-date Excel workbook and a live HTML dashboard covering all 102 employees (74 Olympic Paints + 28 Primeserve). Tracks total worked hours, missed clock-outs, and per-employer / per-department breakdowns. The output is what Sejal and accounts use to run payroll-adjacent decisions and what Quintus reviews each Monday.

Why it exists: Advius's native exports are noisy, don't accumulate across periods, and don't apply the agreed 45-minute lunch+tea deduction. This pipeline normalises the data, applies the deduction once per shift, and surfaces anomalies (missed clock-outs).

How it runs

  1. Continuous (when watcher is running) — haven_watcher.py runs watchdog over Inbox/. When a new .xlsx arrives, validates it has a Sheet0 with data rows, then shells out to build_report.py with --input <new file> --master Output/Clocking Report YTD.xlsx --output Output/. After build success, renames the dated output (e.g. Clocking Report (01.05.2026).xlsx) to overwrite Clocking Report YTD.xlsx, moves the input to Inbox/Archived/, regenerates the dashboard, and emails the YTD file via Outlook.

  2. One-shot alternative — process_inbox.py is the batch version of the watcher. Scans the Inbox once, processes every valid .xlsx, sends emails, exits. Used when the watcher hasn't been running and there are queued files to catch up on.

  3. build_report.py (the core transform) — Reads the raw Advius export (Sheet0, header at row 4), groups by employee + date, computes worked hours, applies a fixed 45-minute deduction per shift (BREAK_DEDUCTION_MINS = 45), classifies the employer (IDs starting SD → Primeserve, all others → Olympic Paints), and appends/updates rows in the YTD master workbook. Critical: must be passed --master. Without it, the script builds a standalone report that does not accumulate.

  4. gen_dashboard.py — Reads Clocking Report YTD.xlsx, generates index.html with 6 tabs (Overview / Yesterday / Daily Attendance / Departments / Weekly Hours / Missing Clock Out), and pushes to the GitHub Pages repo at Output/. The Yesterday tab is data-driven from miss_table filtered to the latest date in the workbook.

  5. Monday 08:00 (Task Scheduler) — haven_dashboard_check.py regenerates the dashboard and sends a Telegram summary to Quintus (chat 8042233389) with the week's totals.

  6. fetch_clocking_email.py — Pulls the Advius export from Sejal's Outlook inbox if she emails it instead of dropping it directly. Triggered manually as needed.

Inputs

  • 2.Areas/11. HR/Clocking Reports/Inbox/Transaction*.xlsx — raw Advius biometric export (Sheet0, header at row 4)
  • 2.Areas/11. HR/Clocking Reports/Output/Clocking Report YTD.xlsx — YTD master accumulator (also an output — read-modify-write)

Outputs

  • 2.Areas/11. HR/Clocking Reports/Output/Clocking Report YTD.xlsx — updated master (this is the file payroll uses)
  • 2.Areas/11. HR/Clocking Reports/Output/index.html — static dashboard
  • Live dashboard: https://op-workspace-dashboard.vercel.app/clocking (Vercel, migrated 2026-05-21 from GH Pages)
  • Outlook emails on every successful run, sent to:
    • accounts@olympicpaints.co.za
    • quintusl@olympicpaints.co.za
    • Two emails per run: (1) YTD Excel attached, (2) Daily missed clock-out HTML summary
  • Telegram summary to chat 8042233389 (Monday morning)
  • Inbox/Archived/<original filename> — moved input

Known failure modes

Symptom Cause Fix
build_report.py builds a fresh report instead of accumulating --master flag missing Always pass --master "<path to YTD.xlsx>". The watcher and process_inbox.py both do this correctly; only an issue if you run build_report.py directly.
Some employees show double hours The Advius export contains overlapping shifts from a manual re-export Check the input file in Inbox/Archived/ for duplicate rows; rebuild from a clean export.
Primeserve / Olympic Paints split wrong Employee ID prefix mis-typed in Advius (e.g. S D012 instead of SD012) Fix the source ID in Advius. The classifier is id.startswith("SD") — strict.
Watcher doesn't fire haven_watcher.py not running, or watching the wrong path Start with python haven_watcher.py. Path is hard-coded to Inbox/. Check C:\Users\quint\.claude\logs\haven\haven_watcher.log.
Yesterday tab empty Latest date in workbook doesn't match calendar yesterday (e.g. weekend gap, public holiday) Expected behaviour — the tab shows the most recent working day, not literally yesterday.
Dashboard not updating despite a successful build gen_dashboard.py push failed (git auth) Re-run manually. Auth uses gh auth token --user FlomaticAuto; see [Memory: reference_github_auth_pattern].
45-min deduction looks wrong Someone tweaked BREAK_DEDUCTION_MINS Constant is at top of build_report.py. Must stay 45 — confirmed by Sejal + Quintus.

Logs

  • C:\Users\quint\.claude\logs\haven\haven_watcher.log — watcher events, build invocations, errors
  • Outlook Sent Items — sent-email audit trail
  • Telegram message history (chat 8042233389) — Monday summaries

Manual run

cd "2.Areas/11. HR/Clocking Reports/scripts"

# One-shot — process whatever's in the Inbox right now
python process_inbox.py

# Build only (skip dashboard / email)
python build_report.py --input "<path to Transaction*.xlsx>" --master "<path to YTD.xlsx>" --output "<output folder>"

# Regenerate the dashboard from the existing YTD workbook
python gen_dashboard.py

# Monday morning summary (also pushes Telegram)
python haven_dashboard_check.py

# Pull a new export from Sejal's email
python fetch_clocking_email.py

# Run the watcher continuously
python haven_watcher.py

Recent incidents

  • 2026-05-21 — Dashboard URL migrated from flomaticauto.github.io/olympic-paints-clocking/ to op-workspace-dashboard.vercel.app/clocking. Old URL now serves a redirect. Do NOT re-introduce the github.io URL in new emails or links.

Related

  • Memory: feedback_haven_clocking_master — always pass --master
  • Memory: feedback_haven_break_deduction — 45 min per shift is canon
  • Memory: agent_haven — HAVEN agent profile, slash-command invocation rules
  • Memory: reference_haven_clocking_dashboard_url — Vercel vs GH Pages URL
  • External: https://op-workspace-dashboard.vercel.app/clocking

runbooks.name: KPI Sales Dashboard
schedule_lines: Manual: weekly, after fresh Weekly_Sales_Report PDFs land
runbooks.purpose: Produce the weekly KPI Sales Dashboard for the management team: MTD sales vs target, rep-by-rep performance, YoY comparison, debtors aging, rock-bottom % per product group. The dashboard is the single canonical "how are we doing this week" view shared at sales meetings.
runbooks.html:
Purpose

Produce the weekly KPI Sales Dashboard for the management team: MTD sales vs target, rep-by-rep performance, YoY comparison, debtors aging, rock-bottom % per product group. The dashboard is the single canonical "how are we doing this week" view shared at sales meetings.

Why it manual rather than automated: QuickSight renders every chart as a raster image, so text extraction from the PDFs is not possible. The KPI numbers must be eyeballed off the PDFs and typed into a Python data block at the top of build_kpi_dashboard.py. This is a deliberate constraint, not a TODO.

How it runs

  1. Sejal or Quintus drops new Weekly_Sales_Report__*.pdf files into 1.Projects/KPI Report/Weekly Progress/ (typically Monday morning).

  2. Quintus opens the PDFs and updates the data block at the top of 1.Projects/AWS Data/build_kpi_dashboard.py:

    • REPORT_WEEK, REPORT_DATE — header strings
    • MTD_SALES, MTD_TARGET, MTD_PCT_TARGET — top KPIs
    • DEBTORS_TOTAL, DEBTORS_90D, OVERDUE_60D_PCT — debtors panel
    • ABOVE_RB_AVG — rock-bottom average %
    • REPS = [...] — per-rep tuples (code, name, sales, target, pct)
    • YOY = [...] — month-by-month current vs prior FY
    • RB_BY_PRODUCT = [...] — rock-bottom % per product group

  3. Run python build_kpi_dashboard.py. The script:

    • Renders index.html using the navy theme + Barlow Condensed
    • Writes index.html into the local GitHub Pages workdir (olympic-paints-kpi/)
    • git add . && git commit && git push to publish
    • Writes kpi_status.json to C:\Users\quint\workspace-dashboard\ so the workspace dashboard sees the latest week

  4. Verify the live URL https://flomaticauto.github.io/olympic-paints-kpi/ shows the new week within a minute.

Inputs

  • 1.Projects/KPI Report/Weekly Progress/Weekly_Sales_Report__*.pdf — the QuickSight PDFs (charts as images; not parseable)
  • Hand-keyed data block in build_kpi_dashboard.py
  • IGNORE: Daily_Sales_Report_P_*.pdf — this is debtor aging for accounts, NOT a KPI source

Outputs

  • index.html in the GitHub Pages repo workdir (<workdir>/olympic-paints-kpi/index.html)
  • Live dashboard: https://flomaticauto.github.io/olympic-paints-kpi/
  • C:\Users\quint\workspace-dashboard\kpi_status.json — consumed by the workspace dashboard

Known failure modes

Symptom Cause Fix
YoY chart shows wrong %s Forgot to update YOY list — only updated the top KPIs Re-edit YOY array to reflect current month's actual; re-run.
Rep target % obviously off Rep target was changed mid-year; old target still in code Update the rep's target value in REPS; the % is computed from sales / target.
git push fails FlomaticAuto token expired or wrong account context Use gh auth token --user FlomaticAuto per the safe-push pattern. See [Memory: feedback_git_push_flomaticauto_safe].
Dashboard published but workspace card stale kpi_status.json write path wrong (e.g. moved repo) Verify path is C:\Users\quint\workspace-dashboard\kpi_status.json.
% to target looks like the previous week Forgot to update REPORT_WEEK / REPORT_DATE AND data block Always update all three header fields + the data block in one pass.
Volume-weighted price increase claim wrong Used aggregate avg R/unit instead of same-product method See [Memory: feedback_price_change_method] — never aggregate R/unit. The +13% April 2026 number is correct; +54.9% was a mix-distortion error.

Logs

  • git log in the KPI Pages repo — every push shows the week that was published
  • Run the script and watch the terminal — there's no separate log file

Manual run

cd "1.Projects/AWS Data"
python build_kpi_dashboard.py

That's the only command. There are no flags — the script does the full render + push every time.

Rep codes (cross-reference)

  • AC — Aboo Cassim
  • AP — Amit Patel
  • BV — Bhadresh Vallabh
  • NP — Nikhil Panchal
  • BM — Byron Minnie

Recent incidents

  • 2026-05-13 — Corrected April 2026 price-increase claim from +54.9% to +13% volume-weighted. Old method was aggregate avg R/unit, which is distorted by mix shift. New method is same-product volume-weighted, which is the correct comp.

runbooks.name: PULSE Daily Mailer (v2)
schedule_lines: Preview Gate + Auto-send: weekday 09:00 (auto-send 30 min later if not actioned)
runbooks.purpose: Send each rep (AC, AP, BV, NP, BM) a personalised daily PULSE email at ~09:00 weekday mornings: their rank, % of target, today's planned stores, yesterday's visits, recovery accounts, and competitor-form status. The email is the rep's daily "what to do today" briefing. Quintus reviews the rendered batch in a Flask preview gate before send.
runbooks.html:
Purpose

Send each rep (AC, AP, BV, NP, BM) a personalised daily PULSE email at ~09:00 weekday mornings: their rank, % of target, today's planned stores, yesterday's visits, recovery accounts, and competitor-form status. The email is the rep's daily "what to do today" briefing. Quintus reviews the rendered batch in a Flask preview gate before send.

Why it exists: PULSE v1 was 9 scripts, 2700 LOC, with two parallel HTML renderers that drifted. v2 consolidated to a single Jinja2-driven pipeline with StrictUndefined so template errors fail loud instead of silently rendering empty cells. Mobile-first because reps read on phones.

How it runs

  1. 08:55 weekday (Task \PULSE v2\Morning Render) — python -m pulse render-daily reads Meetings_Report_AWS.xlsx, the sales parquet, the cycle/plan parquets, and the debtors snapshot. Builds the per-rep payload (pulse/payload.py), renders each rep's email + browser variant via Jinja2 (pulse/render.py). Output: HTML files staged in the v2 working directory, plus JSON snapshots for the Vercel app.

  2. 08:58 weekday (Task \PULSE v2\Publish Web) — python -m pulse publish-web writes the JSON snapshots into the olympic-paints-pulse-v2 repo at public/data/<rep>/{today,week,recovery,store-<accno>}.json, commits, pushes, then explicitly runs vercel deploy --prod (the GitHub auto-deploy is broken — Flomatic GH App permission gap). Pages are force-static + generateStaticParams, so the deploy pre-renders everything.

  3. 09:00 weekday (Task \PULSE v2\Preview Gate) — python -m pulse preview starts a Flask server on localhost:8770 and Telegram-pings Quintus with the preview link. Quintus opens it on the laptop, reviews each rep's email, taps Approve / Tweak / Skip. If no action within 30 minutes, the script auto-sends every approved rep + auto-approves anything not explicitly skipped.

  4. Send phase (triggered from preview or by auto-send timeout) — python -m pulse send calls Outlook via win32com, sets mail.To, mail.HTMLBody, sends, then iterates Outbox and calls .Send() on stuck items (force-flush). Writes a per-rep send log. Telegram-pings Quintus when done.

  5. Daily acknowledgement loop — Each rep email contains a "View today's stores →" CTA to the Vercel page. There is no separate "Acknowledge" button in v2 (removed during the v1→v2 cutover). The \PULSE - Ack Escalation task at 17:15 still runs from v1, Telegram-pings Quintus with any reps who haven't logged any visits.

Inputs

  • Meetings_Report_AWS.xlsx — Zoho meetings sync, read fresh on every run (no cache)
  • Output/sales.parquet — sales invoice rows (~186K rows, Mar 2024–present)
  • <v2 data_dir>/planned_week.json — per-rep, per-day visit plan (built Sun 19:00 by v1 pulse_planner.py)
  • <v2 data_dir>/pulse_cycle.parquet — 4-week cycle mapping per customer per rep
  • <v2 data_dir>/debtors_snapshot.json + debtors_history.json — debtors aging + trend
  • <v2 data_dir>/recovery_accounts.json — recovery list per rep
  • pulse_config.json — rep go-live list, paths, preview public_base URL
  • 1.Projects/PULSE — Sales & Ops Manager/.env — TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN

Outputs

  • 5 Outlook emails (PULSE [<rep>] — Rank #N/5 · X% of target · <day> <date>)
  • JSON snapshots committed to FlomaticAuto/olympic-paints-pulse-v2 and deployed via vercel deploy --prod
  • Live web app: https://olympic-paints-pulse-v2.vercel.app/
  • Telegram pings to chat 8042233389 (preview link, send completion)
  • <v2 data_dir>/send_log.json — per-rep send timestamp + Outlook message ID
  • <v2 data_dir>/approvals.json — Quintus's per-rep approve/skip decisions per date

Known failure modes

Symptom Cause Fix
All 5 emails late or missing Laptop went into Modern Standby overnight; 08:55 task killed Wake laptop manually; run python -m pulse render-daily && python -m pulse publish-web && python -m pulse preview. Long-term fix is plugged-in + power plan tweak.
Emails queued but not sent Outlook not running when send fires Open Outlook, then re-run python -m pulse send --date <today>. The script does its own force-flush but needs Outlook alive.
Template renders empty cells StrictUndefined will normally raise — if it doesn't, payload key is misspelled in template but matches by accident Check pulse/payload.py for the missing key; add it.
Vercel deploy fails vercel CLI auth expired or NODE_OPTIONS=--use-system-ca missing vercel login, then re-run python -m pulse publish-web. Set $env:NODE_OPTIONS = "--use-system-ca" once per shell on this laptop.
Preview server unreachable from phone Wi-Fi router isolating clients Use laptop browser at http://localhost:8770/. LAN access is a known limitation.
Wrong rep gets routed to test inbox pulse_config.json go_live_reps not updated All 5 reps should be in go_live_reps. Add any missing rep; redeploy not needed (config read at runtime).
Scorecard not arriving on alt Mondays v1 task \PULSE — Scorecard was disabled at v2 cutover; v2 port not done Open ticket: port pulse_scorecard.py to v2. Until then, run v1 task manually: re-enable in Task Scheduler for that Monday.

Logs

  • Outlook Sent Items (per-rep send audit)
  • <v2 data_dir>/send_log.json — per-rep timestamp + Outlook message ID
  • Task Scheduler History tab for \PULSE v2\* tasks
  • Telegram message history (chat 8042233389)

Manual run

cd "1.Projects/PULSE v2 — Sales & Ops Manager"

# Render today's emails (no send)
python -m pulse render-daily

# Render a specific date (rebuild after data correction)
python -m pulse render-daily --date 2026-05-21

# Render only one rep
python -m pulse render-daily --reps AC

# Push JSON snapshots + deploy Vercel
python -m pulse publish-web

# Start the preview gate (Telegram-pings Quintus)
python -m pulse preview

# Send approved emails immediately
python -m pulse send

# Send only one rep
python -m pulse send --rep AC

# Status of today's approvals
python -m pulse status

Recent incidents

  • 2026-05-18 — All 5 reps cut over to v2. v1 scheduler tasks disabled but kept registered for rollback.
  • 2026-05-17 — v2 cutover. Replaced v1's pulse_render.py (1825 LOC, two parallel renderers) with Jinja2 templates using StrictUndefined. Eliminated email-vs-browser drift.
  • 2026-05-14 — Morning cluster moved from 06:00/06:30/06:35 to 08:55/08:58/09:00 to escape Modern Standby. v1's register.ps1 file still encodes old times — do NOT re-run it without updating the times first.

Related

  • [[reference_pulse_system]] — v1 historical reference

runbooks.name: Store Health Feedback
runbooks.purpose: Collect competitor intelligence for every account in `Rep_Account_Health.xlsx` (421 accounts across 5 reps), one form per account. Reps fill in which competitors are selling into each account, which product ranges, the main reason for slow purchases, and group/wholesaler affiliation. The collected data flows back into the workbook and powers the Store Health Feedback dashboard plus downstream competitive-strategy work.
runbooks.html:
Purpose

Collect competitor intelligence for every account in Rep_Account_Health.xlsx (421 accounts across 5 reps), one form per account. Reps fill in which competitors are selling into each account, which product ranges, the main reason for slow purchases, and group/wholesaler affiliation. The collected data flows back into the workbook and powers the Store Health Feedback dashboard plus downstream competitive-strategy work.

Why it exists: before this system, competitor visibility was anecdotal. The dispatcher rations work to 5 forms per rep per day so it's a sustainable habit rather than a one-off survey.

How it runs

  1. 07:00 weekdays — send_account_health_reminders.py runs. For each rep with outstanding (dispatched but not yet submitted) forms, sends ONE digest email containing a clickable checklist of every open account, grouped by health tier (At Risk first), highest 12M turnover first. Also re-sends entries whose original dispatch email failed yesterday (status=dispatched + send_error set). Idempotent within a day. Stamps last_reminder_date + bumps reminder_count on each entry.

  2. 08:00 weekdays — build_account_health_forms.py runs. For each rep, computes the lowest-priority tier with any non-complete entries (At Risk → Churning → Good). Picks up to 5 pending entries from that tier (highest turnover first), creates a Supabase form via POST /api/forms/create pre-populated with whatever competitor data already exists in the workbook, sends an Outlook email with the form link, updates account_health_queue.json → status=dispatched. Tier gate: a rep never receives a Churning form until every At Risk is complete.

  3. 10:00 / 14:00 / 16:30 weekdays — poll_account_health_forms.py runs three times. For each dispatched entry, GETs /api/forms/<form_id>/submissions. If a submission exists, extracts field values, writes them into the matching row of Rep_Account_Health.xlsx (matched by Customer Number), marks the queue entry complete, sends a Telegram summary, and triggers a dashboard rebuild via build_store_health_feedback.py.

  4. On-demand — build_store_health_feedback.py reads account_health_queue.json, generates a 5-tab HTML dashboard (Summary / Rep Completion / Feedback Detail / Current Status / Today's Emails), and pushes to GitHub Pages.

Known failure modes

Symptom Cause Fix
Form button not clickable in Outlook <a> wrapping a <table> — Outlook's Word renderer strips it Use bulletproof button pattern: <a> wraps only text inside a <td bgcolor="…">. Already applied in send_account_health_reminders.py:_account_row_html().
dispatched entry with send_error populated Outlook COM -2146959355 "Server execution failed" at 08:00 (boot timing, Office not fully initialised) Reminder script at 07:00 next day auto-rescues — picks up dispatched + send_error entries, re-sends in the digest, clears the error. Permanent fix would be a retry loop in the dispatcher itself.
Dashboard "no emails sent today" but it's past 08:00 Either the 08:00 task didn't run, or every email failed silently Check C:\Users\quint\.claude\logs\account-health-forms\dispatch.log. If empty/missing → check Task Scheduler ran. If full of Email send failed → Outlook COM issue, restart Outlook manually.
Rep gets a Churning form before finishing At Risk Tier-gate logic broken or queue manually edited Check build_account_health_forms.py:707-722 — rep_active_tier should be the lowest priority across all non-complete entries for that rep.
Reminder script sends to wrong inbox rep_emails.json flipped to test mode _test_mode: false should be set; check each rep's email field matches their real zoho_email.
Submissions arrive but workbook doesn't update Poller can't find the customer row by Customer Number Check poll_account_health_forms.py:165-180. Customer Number normalisation (str(...).strip()) — workbook rows may have trailing spaces.
